acceleration.note: full-throttle launch from standstill, automatic gearbox; teleport back to segment start preserves speed when the segment runs out

braking_100_to_0.note: full-throttle run-up, pedal applied the moment v first reaches 100 km/h; distance integrated from pedal onset

coastdown_80.note: pedals released, automatic gearbox in drive (includes CARLA powertrain drag)
